name: Ann Cusack
bio: Ann Cusack (born 22 May 1961, Manhattan, New York) is an American actress and singer, eldest sibling of John Cusack and Joan Cusack. In film, she has appeared in A League of Their Own (1992), Grosse Pointe Blank (1997), Stigmata (1999), and Nightcrawler (2014). On television she is best known for recurring roles on Better Call Saul (2016–2018) and The Boys (2019–2026). She also sings with the blues band Ann Cusack & The Generation Jones Band in Los Angeles.
place: Brooklyn, New York City, New York, USA
